name: Aryan Nations/Church of Jesus Christ Christian
description: Aryan Nations is a white supremacist, neo-Nazi organization founded by Richard Girnt Butler in the mid-1970s, rooted in Christian Identity theology and headquartered at a compound in Hayden Lake, Idaho. The group advocates for the establishment of an Aryan racial homeland and has long served as a central meeting point for far-right extremists. Following a $6.3 million civil judgment in 2000, Butler lost the compound and the group splintered into competing factions; Butler died in September 2004 leaving the organization's future uncertain.
